title: NetworkMachineRole
description: network.machine-role@1: one role a machine can have (plan L34, step M4). A role is what the machine does for the network: a name for the owner, what it installs on the machine and what the hub shows. The catalogue is network.machine-roles@1; a role outside it is refused.

id.description: The role's id: the product that owns it, then what it is (codes.worker, desks.host, ai.host, bot.robot).

name.description: The role's name, in the owner's words.

installs.description: What the role puts on the machine (the job runner, the desk sandbox, the local model server).

shows.description: What the hub shows for a machine with this role.
